name: cloudflare-diagram
title: CloudflareDiagram
description: Cloudflare's services on a Diagram, drawn as a statechart is: the system is a container with its name and what's account-wide, an environment a box in it, each service a card with a header (its name, its product's glyph and name) and labelled sections of chips (its handlers, triggers, settings, machine), a Worker holding its Durable Object classes, an entry marker where requests and schedules come in, and each binding an edge whose label is a card with its name on env and the operations it uses. What it knows comes from a catalog generated from Cloudflare's docs, Wrangler's schema and the Workers types: a connection can only be one the catalog says there is, and editable cards carry their ports on a Connect section. What it's given is a system, which saves as JSON and reads from and writes to wrangler.jsonc, or is read from a workerd config.capnp: it says what's wrong with one, and with editable a search of the catalog adds a service and a service's machine opens in a StateDiagram. Read-only by default. Its board is also a Diagram preset, cloudflareBoardProps(system). No Cloudflare artwork. ELK and XState are optional peers.
